definitions.full: H4508. Minni I. מִנִּי proper name, of a territory region of Armenia ; — Jer 51:27 (|| אַשְׁכְּנַז אֲרָרָט, ); = Assyrian Mannai Schr. COT on the passage; KGF 174.212.520
